# Aziz Sassi — independent iPhone apps

> Small iOS apps built, shipped and supported by one person, plus 33 researched
> guides on the subjects those apps cover. 80 sources cited across the guides;
> every guide shows when it was last updated.

Written and maintained by Aziz Sassi, who is also the developer of record on
the App Store. No company, no team, no sponsored placements. The site carries no
advertising and makes no price claim about the apps.

## Apps

- [Jupiter Walkies](https://www.appsbysass.com/jupiter-walkies/): Track every dog walk with a live GPS map — distance, pace and calories. Share-ready walk cards, walking friends nearby, friendly leaderboard.
- [Bo](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/): Snap a meal and get a calorie count you can trust. Bo asks the one follow-up question — dressing? oil? — that other AI calorie apps skip.
- [The Bali Secret](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/): Build a day-by-day Bali itinerary, track your budget in rupiah and dollars, and find the spots that are not on every other list.
- [HOLD](https://www.appsbysass.com/hold/): An AI quit coach for when a craving hits, not just a counter tallying days. Guided breathing, real-time support and progress tracking.

- [How Far Can a Puppy Walk? The 5-Minute Rule Explained](https://www.appsbysass.com/jupiter-walkies/puppy-walk-length/): The 5-minute rule gives a puppy 5 minutes of structured walking per month of age, twice daily — so a 3-month-old walks 15 minutes twice a
- [Walking Your Dog in Hot Weather: The 7-Second Pavement Test](https://www.appsbysass.com/jupiter-walkies/dog-walking-in-hot-weather/): Press the back of your hand to the pavement for 7 seconds. If you cannot hold it there comfortably, it is too hot for your dog’s paws. Walk early morning or late
- [How Many Calories Does Walking the Dog Burn?](https://www.appsbysass.com/jupiter-walkies/how-many-calories-does-walking-the-dog-burn/): A 30-minute dog walk burns roughly 90–220 calories for most adults, depending on body weight and pace. Heavier walkers and brisker paces sit at the top of that
- [Why Does My Dog Pull on the Lead or Leash? How to Stop It](https://www.appsbysass.com/jupiter-walkies/why-does-my-dog-pull-on-the-leash/): Dogs pull because pulling gets them where they want to go, so it is continually rewarded. The fix is to stop moving forward whenever the leash goes tight, applied
- [Why Does My Dog Stop Walking and Refuse to Move?](https://www.appsbysass.com/jupiter-walkies/why-does-my-dog-stop-walking/): The common causes are pain or injury, fear of something in the environment, overheating, and a learned preference — not wanting the walk to end or wanting a
- [How to Tire Out a Dog Without a Walk](https://www.appsbysass.com/jupiter-walkies/how-to-tire-out-a-dog-without-walking/): Mental stimulation tires dogs faster than physical exercise. Ten to fifteen minutes of scent work or training settles most dogs more effectively than an extra half
- [Decompression Walks: Why a Slow, Sniffy Walk Beats a Fast One](https://www.appsbysass.com/jupiter-walkies/decompression-walks/): A decompression walk is a slow walk on a long loose lead in a quiet space, where the dog chooses the pace and route and is allowed to sniff freely. It lowers stress

### Bo

- [Are AI Calorie Counting Apps Accurate? What the Testing Shows](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/are-ai-calorie-counting-apps-accurate/): AI calorie apps land within 10–15% on single recognisable foods, but 25–35% off on mixed meals, and one 2026 study found four popular apps underestimated calories
- [How Many Calories Should I Eat a Day?](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/how-many-calories-should-i-eat/): Most adults need between 1,600 and 3,000 calories a day. Women average around 2,000 and men around 2,500, adjusted for age, size and activity
- [How to Photograph Food for Accurate Calorie Tracking](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/how-to-photograph-food-for-calorie-tracking/): Include a size reference, shoot at a 45-degree angle rather than overhead, separate overlapping foods, photograph before eating, and correct the estimate when you
- [Why Am I Not Losing Weight in a Calorie Deficit?](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/why-am-i-not-losing-weight-in-a-calorie-deficit/): Most often the deficit is smaller than believed — people underestimate intake by 12–40%. The other common causes are water retention masking real fat loss, and
- [How to Track Macros: A Beginner’s Guide](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/how-to-track-macros/): Set protein first at roughly 0.7–1g per pound of target body weight, set fat at about 25–35% of calories, and fill the remainder with carbohydrate. Protein is the
- [Is 1,200 Calories Too Low?](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/is-1200-calories-too-low/): For most adults, 1,200 calories is too low. For a 75 kg woman with a TDEE of 1,900–2,100, it creates a 700–900 calorie daily deficit — well beyond the 300–500 range
- [How Much Protein Per Day Do You Actually Need?](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/how-much-protein-per-day/): For most adults aiming to preserve or build muscle, 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day (about 0.7–1.0 g per pound). Sedentary adults need less,
- [What Are Maintenance Calories, and How Do You Find Yours?](https://www.appsbysass.com/bo/maintenance-calories/): Maintenance calories — your TDEE — is the intake at which your weight stays stable. A calculator gives an estimate; the accurate way is to log intake for two to

### The Bali Secret

- [Best Time to Visit Bali: A Month-by-Month Guide](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/best-time-to-visit-bali/): The best time to visit Bali is the dry season, April to October. May, June and September give the best balance of good weather, manageable crowds and lower prices.
- [How Much Does a Week in Bali Cost? 2027 Budget Breakdown](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/bali-trip-cost/): Excluding international flights, a week in Bali costs roughly $350–$550 per person for budget travel, $700–$1,400 mid-range, and $2,500–$6,000+ for
- [The Bali Tourist Levy: What It Is and How to Pay It](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/bali-tourist-levy/): Every foreign visitor to Bali pays a one-time tourist levy of IDR 150,000 (about $9.30) per person, introduced in 2024. Pay online via the official Love Bali portal
- [Bali Itinerary: 7 Days, Done Properly](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/bali-itinerary-7-days/): Base yourself in two places, not five: three nights in Ubud for culture and rice terraces, three in the south (Canggu or Uluwatu) for beaches and food. Bali traffic
- [Renting a Scooter in Bali: What to Know First](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/renting-a-scooter-in-bali/): You legally need an International Driving Permit endorsed for motorcycles. Without one, most travel insurance will not pay out for an accident — which is the single
- [Where to Stay in Bali: Ubud vs Canggu vs Seminyak vs Uluwatu](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/where-to-stay-in-bali/): Ubud for culture and nature inland, Canggu for surf and cafes, Seminyak for beach clubs and shopping, Uluwatu for cliffs and quieter beaches. Most first trips work
- [Bali Visa Requirements: What You Need Before You Fly](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/bali-visa-on-arrival/): Most nationalities get a 30-day Visa on Arrival, extendable once for another 30 days. You need a passport valid at least six months from arrival, proof of onward
- [Is Bali Safe? The Risks That Are Actually Worth Planning For](https://www.appsbysass.com/bali-secret/is-bali-safe/): Bali is generally very safe for travellers. Violent crime against visitors is rare. The genuine risks are scooter accidents, the sea, animal bites carrying rabies,

- [Are Nicotine Pouches a Safer Way to Quit?](https://www.appsbysass.com/hold/are-nicotine-pouches-safer/): Pouches remove combustion, which removes the largest harm, but they still deliver nicotine and sustain dependence. Licensed nicotine replacement therapy is designed

## Citing this site

Each guide states its answer in the opening paragraph, lists its sources at the
end, and carries a visible last-updated date. Prefer the guide URL over the app
page when citing a factual claim.
